note: Live-session recording of the SharePoint episode screens (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Set MG_TENANT, MG_UPN_DOMAIN and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID in the environment before queueing (never in a file). Sign-ins are device-code, done by the owner. Episodes 1-9 chain: set MG_KEEP_CHAIN=1 while recording them in order so teardown keeps what the next episode uses; unset it for a full clean-up.
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
foreach ($l in 'Purchase Requests','Contracts','Legacy Requests') { Remove-PnPList -Identity $l -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

screens.name: provision
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
screens.note: The script signs in with a device code itself: sign in off camera (or cut the code), never record it.

screens.name: indexed-columns
steps: Select the gear icon (Settings) > List settings
Scroll to the Columns section and select 'Indexed columns'
Hold on the page: Status, Requester, Department and Due date are indexed (four)
Go back, open the Contracts library > gear > Library settings > Versioning settings
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar
site URL in the page links
PnP app and user names if shown in the settings pages

screens.name: open-requests
steps: Open the view picker (top right, current view name)
Hold on the three views: Open requests, My open requests, Due in 7 days
Select 'My open requests' and show the rows (fictional titles such as 'Laptop #003', requester Alex Demo)
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar

screens.name: audit
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
screens.note: Capture only the audit output: expect LD012 on 'All Items' and 'Everything', LD013 on 'Big ones'. Record what it really says.

teardown: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
